gloss: power of discrimination; discernment; ability to distinguish

definitions.gloss: power of discrimination; discernment; ability to distinguish

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}の{識別力|しきべつりょく}を{検査|けんさ}する。
examples.english: To test one's ability to distinguish colors.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}むことで{味|あじ}の{識別力|しきべつりょく}が{高|たか}まる。
examples.english: Your ability to distinguish flavors improves with experience.

examples.japanese: このAIシステムは{人間|にんげん}の{顔|かお}に{対|たい}する{高|たか}い{識別力|しきべつりょく}を{持|も}ち、{双子|ふたご}でも{見分|みわ}けることができる。
examples.english: This AI system has a high ability to distinguish human faces and can even tell twins apart.

notes:
A compound of {識別|しきべつ} (identification, discrimination) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Refers to the capacity to perceive differences between similar things, whether sensory (colors, sounds, tastes), intellectual (quality judgments), or technological (pattern recognition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {識別力|しきべつりょく}が{高|たか}い: to have high discernment
- {識別力|しきべつりょく}を{養|やしな}う: to cultivate discernment
- {色|いろ}の{識別力|しきべつりょく}: color discrimination ability
- {識別力|しきべつりょく}に{優|すぐ}れる: to excel in discernment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {判断力|はんだんりょく}: judgment, decision-making ability (broader; about making good decisions, not just perceiving differences)
- {鑑識力|かんしきりょく}: connoisseurship, expert appraisal ability (implies trained expertise in evaluating quality)
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく}: insight, perceptiveness (ability to see hidden truths, not just surface differences)
